features.name: Full v160.8 Content Catalog (922 Records / 447 Buildings)
features.notes: All 922 upstream content records and 447 building factories initialize on ARM11; physical hardware >= 24 FPS verification pending.

features.name: .msav Map Loading & Embedded Startup Loader
features.notes: Upstream SaveIO/MapIO streaming decode runs on ARM11 and is linked as the default min3dstry.3dsx startup path.

features.name: .msav Save Writing, Reload & Persistence
features.notes: SaveIO write and reload across Azahar Boot 1 -> Boot 2 persists tiles, core inventory, buildings, GameStats, and Rules.

features.name: Full 4-Page World Atlas, Terrain & Layered Building Draw
features.notes: All 4 upstream atlas pages (5,200 regions), animated fluids, cracks, and BlockRenderer static/dynamic layers render on ARM11.

features.name: Player Unit Ore Mining & Core Deposit
features.notes: Touch Mine targeting, mining laser beam, ore harvesting, and automatic core copper/lead deposit work live on ARM11.

features.name: Mechanical & Pneumatic Drills (Automated Extraction)
features.notes: Drill resource extraction ticks, rotary/top sprite layers, and item output into conveyors and cores run live on ARM11.

features.name: Conveyors, Routers, Junctions, Sorters & Core Storage
features.notes: Belt transport, routers, junctions, overflow/underflow gates, configurable sorters, and core item storage run live on ARM11.

features.name: Generic Crafters & Multi-Item Production Chains
features.notes: Full upstream crafter ticks verified in ARM11 production-ticks probe; live draw covers select blocks (Graphite Press, Phase Weaver, Overdrive), full crafter set and FX pending.

features.name: Power Grids, Generators, Nodes & Batteries
features.notes: PowerGraph and GraphUpdater ticks verified in ARM11 probe; live draw covers Combustion Generator and PowerNode beams; power HUD bar and full reactor/battery coverage pending.

features.name: Liquid Pumps, Conduits, Routers & Bridges
features.notes: LiquidModule and Conduit simulation verified in ARM11 probe; live draw covers Conduit tiling; full pump, tank, bridge, and liquid HUD coverage pending.

features.name: Payload Conveyors, Unit Factories & Reconstructors
features.notes: PayloadConveyorBuild draw is wired in network-render; full payload routing, unit factory build queues, and reconstructor loops are not yet wired/verified.

features.name: Touch Build, Rotate (R), Deconstruct (B) & BuildPlans
features.notes: Stylus tile placement, 4-way rotation, deconstruction, and BuildPlan queue execution work live in offline and multiplayer ARM11 builds.

features.name: Unlocked Block Catalog Menu & Sorter Item Config
features.notes: Full unlocked block catalog with 425/447 icons and bottom-screen Sorter item configuration work live on ARM11; other block config UIs (bridges/factories/processors) pending.

features.name: Stock v160.8 Fonts, Localization Bundles & World Labels
features.notes: Upstream bitmap/TTF font rasterization, inline emoji icons, locale bundles (incl. JP), and world objective markers/labels render on ARM11.

features.name: Top-Screen Status HUD (Wave, Copper, Enemies & Objectives)
features.notes: Stock Wave, Enemies Remaining, Core Copper, and Map Objective HUD rows render live on top screen; multi-item core inventory and power HUD pending.

features.name: Session Controls (Pause/Resume, Next Wave, Quick-Save)
features.notes: X pause/resume, Y wave trigger, and SELECT quick-save work in offline single-player; interactive pause menu overlay not yet wired to upstream runtime.

features.name: Upstream Minimap & Interactive Pause Menu Overlay
features.notes: Verified in the C platform harness (min3dstry.3dsx) only; not yet bound to upstream Mindustry world state or runtime menu controls.

features.name: Core Database, Schematics & RTS Unit Command
features.notes: Content database UI, blueprint schematics copy/paste, and RTS unit selection/command are not yet implemented.

features.name: Stock Title Menu & Settings Shell (Play / Settings / Quit)
features.notes: Navigation shell with upstream v160.8 MenuFragment keys/labels; Play->Campaign, Settings mute/lighting/camera, and Database->About are wired. The upstream Scene2D fragment, schematic/core-database UIs and RTS remain unimplemented.

features.name: Player Unit Flight/Movement & Follow Camera
features.notes: Circle Pad and D-Pad player movement (Alpha/Gamma) with top-screen camera follow work live in offline and multiplayer ARM11 builds.

features.name: Enemy Wave Spawner & Ground Flowfield Pathfinding
features.notes: Upstream WaveSpawner, Pathfinder, and ControlPathfinder ground flowfields match JVM bit-for-bit and drive live Dagger waves on ARM11.

features.name: Turret Targeting, Ammo Feed, Projectiles & Unit Destruction
features.notes: Duo/Scatter targeting, ammo consumption, bullet hits, and kills are ARM11-verified in probes and multiplayer; live offline bullet draw wired, full turret catalog/beams/status effects pending.

features.name: Complete Unit Types (Mechs/Legs/Naval/Bosses) & Player Aim/Fire
features.notes: 14 unit types draw in offline singleplayer and 37 (incl. naval wakes and tank treads) in network-render; full Serpulo/Erekir unit abilities and manual player weapon aim/fire are in progress.

features.name: Dynamic Lighting, Weather, Particle Effects & Camera Zoom
features.notes: Camera zoom, bloom/glow, and particle prototypes exist in the C Citro2D harness only; upstream world renderer has no dynamic lighting, weather, particle FX, or zoom yet.

features.name: Mindustry Logic VM (LogicOp / LExecutor) Parity
features.notes: Upstream LogicOp/LExecutor instruction parity verified on ARM11 in standalone logic probe; not yet enabled in live interactive runtime.

features.name: In-World Processors, Logic Displays & Editor UI
features.notes: Live processor building execution, logic display rendering, world-processor markers/messages, and bottom-screen logic editor UI are not yet merged on main.

features.name: Campaign Sector State, Tech-Tree Data, Planet Grid & Saves.load
features.notes: All 12 campaign probes (sector info, planet state, research unlock state, slot discovery, and Saves.load) pass on ARM11 in Azahar; headless probes only.

features.name: Interactive Planet Map, Sector Launch & Tech-Tree Unlock UI
features.notes: Planet sector picker, launch loadout UI, interactive tech-tree graph, and background sector attack/export simulation are not yet merged on main.

features.name: Erekir Content & Mechanics (Ducts, Heat, Neoplasm, Sectors)
features.notes: Basic duct and beryllium wall draw shortcuts exist in network-render, but Erekir heat, neoplasm, duct logistics simulation, units, and campaign sectors are not yet implemented.

features.name: Upstream Sounds / Musics Trigger & Catalog Parity
features.notes: Real upstream gameplay audio triggers (place, drill, shoot, hit, explosion) match JVM in ARM11 audio-ticks probe; not yet wired to NDSP playback in interactive app.

features.name: NDSP Hardware Mixer & Tremor OGG Music Streamer Backend
features.notes: 24-channel NDSP mixer, 16 staged OGG music tracks, and double-buffered Tremor decoder are verified in C harness and Azahar; awaiting bridge into upstream TeaVM runtime.

features.name: Live In-Game Upstream SFX, Ambience & Dynamic Soundtrack
features.notes: Live upstream Sound.at / Music.play playback (turrets, drills, explosions, UI clicks, ambient hum, dynamic tracks) is not yet merged into the interactive ARM11 app.

features.name: Cross-Platform Multiplayer Client (Unmodified Java PC v160.8)
features.notes: Wire-exact TCP/UDP client connects to stock Java PC v160.8 server in Azahar with live movement, mining, touch build, HUD, and combat snapshots.

features.name: 3DS Multiplayer Host/LAN Server & In-App Server Browser
features.notes: Hosting a game from 3DS, LAN discovery/broadcast, direct IP entry UI, and server list browser are not yet implemented.

features.name: Unified Playable .3dsx (Offline + Campaign + MP + Audio + UI)
features.notes: Offline singleplayer, live multiplayer (network-render), embedded save loader, campaign probes, and NDSP audio currently live in separate targets rather than one unified .3dsx.

features.name: Physical Old (64 MiB) & New 3DS Hardware >= 24 FPS Parity
features.notes: Unoptimized Azahar offline baseline is 4.72 FPS (New 3DS) / 3.48 FPS (Old 3DS) at 44.44 MiB Old 3DS static subtotal; physical Old & New 3DS runs and >= 24 FPS optimization are pending.
